contracts.whole_body:
Public Shared Function BuildGeeTimeLabels(model As GEE, size As Integer) As String()
            Dim labels(size - 1) As String

            Dim dict = model.TimesDict
            If dict Is Nothing OrElse dict.Count <> size Then
                For i As Integer = 0 To size - 1
                    labels(i) = "t" & (i + 1).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                Next
                Return labels
            End If

            For Each kvp In dict
                Dim idx As Integer = kvp.Value
                If idx >= 0 AndAlso idx < size Then
                    labels(idx) = "t=" & kvp.Key.ToString("0.###############", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                End If
            Next

            For i As Integer = 0 To size - 1
                If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(labels(i)) Then
                    labels(i) = "t" & (i + 1).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                End If
            Next

            Return labels
        End Function

Public Shared Function BuildParameterNames(predictorNames() As String, coefficientCount As Integer) As String()
            If coefficientCount < 1 Then Return New String() {}

            Dim out(coefficientCount - 1) As String
            out(0) = "Intercept"
            Dim source() As String = If(predictorNames, New String() {})
            For i As Integer = 1 To coefficientCount - 1
                Dim srcIndex As Integer = i - 1
                If srcIndex < source.Length Then
                    out(i) = source(srcIndex)
                Else
                    out(i) = "Param" & (i + 1).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                End If
            Next
            Return out
        End Function

contracts.whole_body:
Public Shared Function GetVariableNames(expectedCount As Integer,
                                                isMissing As Func(Of Boolean),
                                                scalarText As Func(Of String),
                                                acquireRange As Func(Of UdfVariableNameRange38)) As String()
            If expectedCount <= 0 Then Return New String() {}

            Dim fallback(expectedCount - 1) As String
            For i As Integer = 0 To expectedCount - 1
                fallback(i) = "X" & (i + 1).ToString()
            Next

            If isMissing() Then Return fallback

            Dim s As String = scalarText()
            If s IsNot Nothing Then
                Dim parts As String() = s.Split({","c}, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries)
                If parts.Length = expectedCount Then
                    For i As Integer = 0 To expectedCount - 1
                        parts(i) = parts(i).Trim()
                        If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(parts(i)) Then parts(i) = fallback(i)
                    Next
                    Return parts
                End If
            End If

            Dim arr As UdfVariableNameRange38 = acquireRange()
            If arr Is Nothing Then Return fallback

            Dim rows As Integer = arr.RowCount
            Dim cols As Integer = arr.ColumnCount
            Dim list As New List(Of String)()

            If rows = 1 AndAlso cols >= 1 Then
                For j As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
                    list.Add(arr.ReadText(0, j))
                Next
            ElseIf cols = 1 AndAlso rows >= 1 Then
                For i As Integer = 0 To rows - 1
                    list.Add(arr.ReadText(i, 0))
                Next
            End If

            If list.Count = expectedCount Then
                For i As Integer = 0 To expectedCount - 1
                    If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(list(i)) Then list(i) = fallback(i)
                Next
                Return list.ToArray()
            End If

            Return fallback
        End Function

Public Shared Function GetVariableNames(expectedCount As Integer,
                                                isMissing As Func(Of Boolean),
                                                scalarText As Func(Of String),
                                                acquireRange As Func(Of UdfVariableNameRange38)) As String()
            If expectedCount <= 0 Then Return New String() {}

            Dim fallback(expectedCount - 1) As String
            For i As Integer = 0 To expectedCount - 1
                fallback(i) = "X" & (i + 1).ToString()
            Next

            If isMissing() Then Return fallback

            Dim s As String = scalarText()
            If s IsNot Nothing Then
                Dim parts As String() = s.Split({","c}, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries)
                If parts.Length = expectedCount Then
                    For i As Integer = 0 To expectedCount - 1
                        parts(i) = parts(i).Trim()
                        If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(parts(i)) Then parts(i) = fallback(i)
                    Next
                    Return parts
                End If
            End If

            Dim arr As UdfVariableNameRange38 = acquireRange()
            If arr Is Nothing Then Return fallback

            Dim rows As Integer = arr.RowCount
            Dim cols As Integer = arr.ColumnCount
            Dim list As New List(Of String)()

            If rows = 1 AndAlso cols >= 1 Then
                For j As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
                    list.Add(arr.ReadText(0, j))
                Next
            ElseIf cols = 1 AndAlso rows >= 1 Then
                For i As Integer = 0 To rows - 1
                    list.Add(arr.ReadText(i, 0))
                Next
            End If

            If list.Count = expectedCount Then
                For i As Integer = 0 To expectedCount - 1
                    If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(list(i)) Then list(i) = fallback(i)
                Next
                Return list.ToArray()
            End If

            Return fallback
        End Function

Public Shared Sub InitializeResponsePredictorsPrepared(rowCount As Integer, _
            totalCols As Integer, _
            xCols As Integer, _
            yName As String, _
            predictorNames As String(), _
            yCol As Object(,), _
            xMat As Object(,), _
            ByRef raw As Object(,), _
            ByRef names As String())
            ReDim raw(rowCount - 1, totalCols - 1)
            ReDim names(totalCols - 1)

            names(0) = If(String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(yName), "Y", yName)
            For i As Integer = 0 To rowCount - 1
                raw(i, 0) = yCol(i, 0)
            Next

            For j As Integer = 0 To xCols - 1
                names(j + 1) = predictorNames(j)
                For i As Integer = 0 To rowCount - 1
                    raw(i, j + 1) = xMat(i, j)
                Next
            Next

        End Sub

Public Shared Sub InitializeCoxPrepared(rowCount As Integer, _
            totalCols As Integer, _
            xCols As Integer, _
            timeName As String, _
            statusName As String, _
            strataName As String, _
            predictorNames As String(), _
            timeCol As Object(,), _
            statusCol As Object(,), _
            strataCol As Object(,), _
            xMat As Object(,), _
            hasStrata As Boolean, _
            ByRef raw As Object(,), _
            ByRef names As String())
            ReDim raw(rowCount - 1, totalCols - 1)
            ReDim names(totalCols - 1)

            names(0) = If(String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(timeName), "Time", timeName)
            names(1) = If(String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(statusName), "Status", statusName)

            For i As Integer = 0 To rowCount - 1
                raw(i, 0) = timeCol(i, 0)
                raw(i, 1) = statusCol(i, 0)
            Next

            Dim firstPredictorCol As Integer = 2
            If hasStrata Then
                names(2) = If(String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(strataName), "Strata", strataName)
                For i As Integer = 0 To rowCount - 1
                    raw(i, 2) = strataCol(i, 0)
                Next
                firstPredictorCol = 3
            End If

            For j As Integer = 0 To xCols - 1
                names(firstPredictorCol + j) = predictorNames(j)
                For i As Integer = 0 To rowCount - 1
                    raw(i, firstPredictorCol + j) = xMat(i, j)
                Next

Public Shared Sub InitializeCoxPrepared(rowCount As Integer, _
            totalCols As Integer, _
            xCols As Integer, _
            timeName As String, _
            statusName As String, _
            strataName As String, _
            predictorNames As String(), _
            timeCol As Object(,), _
            statusCol As Object(,), _
            strataCol As Object(,), _
            xMat As Object(,), _
            hasStrata As Boolean, _
            ByRef raw As Object(,), _
            ByRef names As String())
            ReDim raw(rowCount - 1, totalCols - 1)
            ReDim names(totalCols - 1)

            names(0) = If(String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(timeName), "Time", timeName)
            names(1) = If(String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(statusName), "Status", statusName)

            For i As Integer = 0 To rowCount - 1
                raw(i, 0) = timeCol(i, 0)
                raw(i, 1) = statusCol(i, 0)
            Next

            Dim firstPredictorCol As Integer = 2
            If hasStrata Then
                names(2) = If(String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(strataName), "Strata", strataName)
                For i As Integer = 0 To rowCount - 1
                    raw(i, 2) = strataCol(i, 0)
                Next
                firstPredictorCol = 3
            End If

            For j As Integer = 0 To xCols - 1
                names(firstPredictorCol + j) = predictorNames(j)
                For i As Integer = 0 To rowCount - 1
                    raw(i, firstPredictorCol + j) = xMat(i, j)
                Next
            Next

        End Sub

Public Shared Function TryGetLooseNumericTextPrepared(s As String, ByRef values As Double()) As Boolean
            Dim parts As String() = s.Split({","c, ";"c, " "c, Convert.ToChar(9)}, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries)
            If parts.Length < 1 Then Return False

            ReDim values(parts.Length - 1)
            For i As Integer = 0 To parts.Length - 1
                Dim parsed As Double
                If Not Double.TryParse(parts(i), Global.System.Globalization.NumberStyles.Float Or Global.System.Globalization.NumberStyles.AllowThousands, Global.System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, parsed) AndAlso
                   Not Double.TryParse(parts(i), Global.System.Globalization.NumberStyles.Float Or Global.System.Globalization.NumberStyles.AllowThousands, Global.System.Globalization.CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, parsed) Then
                    values = Nothing
                    Return False
                End If
                If Double.IsNaN(parsed) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(parsed) Then
                    values = Nothing
                    Return False
                End If
                values(i) = parsed
            Next
            Return True
        End Function

Public Shared Function TryReadProbabilityThresholdsPrepared(rows As Integer, cols As Integer,
            appendCell As Func(Of Integer, Integer, List(Of Double), Boolean), ByRef thresholds() As Double) As Boolean
        If rows <> 1 AndAlso cols <> 1 Then Return False

        Dim values As New List(Of Double)()
        If rows = 1 Then
            For j As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
                If Not appendCell(0, j, values) Then Return False
            Next
        Else
            For i As Integer = 0 To rows - 1
                If Not appendCell(i, 0, values) Then Return False
            Next
        End If

        If values.Count = 0 Then Return True

        values.Sort()
        Dim uniqueValues As New List(Of Double)(values.Count)
        For i As Integer = 0 To values.Count - 1
            If i = 0 OrElse Math.Abs(values(i) - values(i - 1)) > 0.000000000001R Then
                uniqueValues.Add(values(i))
            End If
        Next

        thresholds = uniqueValues.ToArray()
        Return True
        End Function

Public Shared Function TryReadProbabilityThresholdsPrepared(rows As Integer, cols As Integer,
            appendCell As Func(Of Integer, Integer, List(Of Double), Boolean), ByRef thresholds() As Double) As Boolean
        If rows <> 1 AndAlso cols <> 1 Then Return False

        Dim values As New List(Of Double)()
        If rows = 1 Then
            For j As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
                If Not appendCell(0, j, values) Then Return False
            Next
        Else
            For i As Integer = 0 To rows - 1
                If Not appendCell(i, 0, values) Then Return False
            Next
        End If

        If values.Count = 0 Then Return True

        values.Sort()
        Dim uniqueValues As New List(Of Double)(values.Count)
        For i As Integer = 0 To values.Count - 1
            If i = 0 OrElse Math.Abs(values(i) - values(i - 1)) > 0.000000000001R Then
                uniqueValues.Add(values(i))
            End If
        Next

        thresholds = uniqueValues.ToArray()
        Return True

Public Shared Function ParseResidualType(v As String) As ResidualType
            Dim s As String = v
            If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(s) Then Return ResidualType.Martingale
            Select Case LegacyUdfText38.CaseToken(s.Trim().ToLowerInvariant(), New String() {"martingale", "deviance", "schoenfeld", "dfbeta"})
                Case "martingale" : Return ResidualType.Martingale
                Case "deviance" : Return ResidualType.Deviance
                Case "schoenfeld" : Return ResidualType.Schoenfeld
                Case "dfbeta" : Return ResidualType.Dfbeta
                Case Else : Return ResidualType.Martingale
            End Select
        End Function

source_record.signature: Public Shared Function ParseGeeCovarianceName(v As String) As String

contracts.whole_body:
Public Shared Function ParseGeeCovarianceName(v As String) As String
            Dim s As String = v
            If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(s) Then Return "Independence"

            Select Case LegacyUdfText38.CaseToken(NormalizeKey(s), New String() {"independence", "independent", "id", "identity", "exchangeable", "exchangable", "compoundsymmetry", "cs", "exch", "exchangeablecs", "compoundsymmetrycs", "autoregressive", "ar1", "ar", "autoregressivear1", "ar1autoregressive", "toeplitz", "toep", "toeplitztoep", "toeptoeplitz", "stationary", "stationarymdependent", "unstructured", "un", "uns", "unstructuredun"})
                Case "independence", "independent", "id", "identity"
                    Return "Independence"
                Case "exchangeable", "exchangable", "compoundsymmetry", "cs", "exch", "exchangeablecs", "compoundsymmetrycs"
                    Return "Exchangable"
                Case "autoregressive", "ar1", "ar", "autoregressivear1", "ar1autoregressive"
                    Return "Autoregressive"
                Case "toeplitz", "toep", "toeplitztoep", "toeptoeplitz", "stationary", "stationarymdependent"
                    Return "Toeplitz"
                Case "unstructured", "un", "uns", "unstructuredun"
                    Return "Unstructured"
                Case Else
                    Return Nothing
            End Select
        End Function

Public Shared Function ParseGeeCovarianceName(v As String) As String
            Dim s As String = v
            If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(s) Then Return "Independence"

            Select Case LegacyUdfText38.CaseToken(NormalizeKey(s), New String() {"independence", "independent", "id", "identity", "exchangeable", "exchangable", "compoundsymmetry", "cs", "exch", "exchangeablecs", "compoundsymmetrycs", "autoregressive", "ar1", "ar", "autoregressivear1", "ar1autoregressive", "toeplitz", "toep", "toeplitztoep", "toeptoeplitz", "stationary", "stationarymdependent", "unstructured", "un", "uns", "unstructuredun"})
                Case "independence", "independent", "id", "identity"
                    Return "Independence"
                Case "exchangeable", "exchangable", "compoundsymmetry", "cs", "exch", "exchangeablecs", "compoundsymmetrycs"
                    Return "Exchangable"
                Case "autoregressive", "ar1", "ar", "autoregressivear1", "ar1autoregressive"
                    Return "Autoregressive"
                Case "toeplitz", "toep", "toeplitztoep", "toeptoeplitz", "stationary", "stationarymdependent"
                    Return "Toeplitz"
                Case "unstructured", "un", "uns", "unstructuredun"
                    Return "Unstructured"
                Case Else
                    Return Nothing
            End Select
        End Function

Public Shared Function ParseGeeStandardErrorType(v As String) As String
            Dim s As String = v
            If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(s) Then Return "Robust"

            Select Case LegacyUdfText38.CaseToken(NormalizeKey(s), New String() {"robust", "sandwich", "empirical", "naive", "modelbased", "model", "biasreduced", "biascorrected", "biascorr", "manclderouen"})
                Case "robust", "sandwich", "empirical"
                    Return "Robust"
                Case "naive", "modelbased", "model"
                    Return "Naive"
                Case "biasreduced", "biascorrected", "biascorr", "manclderouen"
                    Return "Bias Reduced"
                Case Else
                    Return Nothing
            End Select
        End Function

contracts.whole_body:
Public Shared Function ParseGeeResidualType(v As String) As String
            Dim s As String = v
            If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(s) Then Return "all"

            Select Case LegacyUdfText38.CaseToken(NormalizeKey(s), New String() {"all", "raw", "response", "deviance", "dev", "pearson", "stdpearson", "standardizedpearson", "scaledpearson", "stddeviance", "standardizeddeviance", "scaleddeviance", "working", "work"})
                Case "all"
                    Return "all"
                Case "raw", "response"
                    Return "raw"
                Case "deviance", "dev"
                    Return "deviance"
                Case "pearson"
                    Return "pearson"
                Case "stdpearson", "standardizedpearson", "scaledpearson"
                    Return "stdpearson"
                Case "stddeviance", "standardizeddeviance", "scaleddeviance"
                    Return "stddeviance"
                Case "working", "work"
                    Return "working"
                Case Else
                    Return "all"
            End Select
        End Function

            Dim s As String = arg

            Dim s As String = arg
            If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(s) Then Return "Gaussian"

            Select Case LegacyUdfText38.CaseToken(NormalizeRegressionOptionKey(s), New String() {"binomial", "binary", "logistic", "poisson", "count", "negativebinomial", "negativebinom", "negativebin", "negbin", "nb", "nb2", "gaussian", "normal", "gamma"})
                Case "binomial", "binary", "logistic"

                Case "negativebinomial", "negativebinom", "negativebin", "negbin", "nb", "nb2"
                    Return "NegativeBinomial"
                Case "gaussian", "normal"

Public Shared Function GetRegressionLinkName(arg As String, familyDisplayName As String) As String
            Dim s As String = arg
            If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(s) Then
                Return Global.BESHStatNG.regression.GetCanonicalLinkFromDisplayName(familyDisplayName)
            End If

            Select Case LegacyUdfText38.CaseToken(NormalizeRegressionOptionKey(s), New String() {"logit", "probit", "log", "identity", "id", "sqrt", "squareroot", "inverse", "reciprocal", "power"})
                Case "logit"
                    Return "Logit"
                Case "probit"
                    Return "Probit"
                Case "log"
                    Return "Log"
                Case "identity", "id"
                    Return "Identity"
                Case "sqrt", "squareroot"
                    Return "Sqrt"
                Case "inverse", "reciprocal"
                    Return "Inverse"
                Case "power"
                    Return "Power"
                Case Else
                    Return Nothing
            End Select

            Dim s As String = arg
            If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(s) Then
                Return Global.BESHStatNG.regression.GetCanonicalLinkFromDisplayName(familyDisplayName)
            End If

            Select Case LegacyUdfText38.CaseToken(NormalizeRegressionOptionKey(s), New String() {"logit", "probit", "log", "identity", "id", "sqrt", "squareroot", "inverse", "reciprocal", "power"})
                Case "logit"
                    Return "Logit"
                Case "probit"
                    Return "Probit"
                Case "log"
                    Return "Log"
                Case "identity", "id"
                    Return "Identity"
                Case "sqrt", "squareroot"
                    Return "Sqrt"
                Case "inverse", "reciprocal"
                    Return "Inverse"
                Case "power"
                    Return "Power"
                Case Else
                    Return Nothing
            End Select
        End Function

contracts.whole_body:
Public Shared Function NormalizeRegressionOptionKey(value As String) As String
            If value Is Nothing Then Return String.Empty

            Dim chars As New List(Of Char)()
            For Each ch As Char In value.Trim().ToLowerInvariant()
                If Char.IsLetterOrDigit(ch) Then chars.Add(ch)
            Next

            Return New String(chars.ToArray())
        End Function

Public Shared Function NormalizeMatchToken(value As String, Optional toUpper As Boolean = True, Optional removeUnderscore As Boolean = False) As String
            If value Is Nothing Then Return String.Empty

            Dim normalized As String = value.Trim()
            normalized = If(toUpper, normalized.ToUpperInvariant(), normalized.ToLowerInvariant())
            normalized = normalized.Replace(" ", String.Empty).Replace("-", String.Empty)
            If removeUnderscore Then normalized = normalized.Replace("_", String.Empty)
            Return normalized
        End Function

Public Shared Function NormalizeMatchToken(value As String, Optional toUpper As Boolean = True, Optional removeUnderscore As Boolean = False) As String
            If value Is Nothing Then Return String.Empty

        For i As Integer = rows - 1 To 0 Step -1

Public Shared Function HasNumericColumnHeader(lastRow As Integer, columns As Integer, blank As Func(Of Integer, Integer, Boolean), numeric As Func(Of Integer, Integer, Boolean)) As Boolean
        If lastRow < 1 Then Return False
        If blank(0, 0) Then Return False

        Return (Not firstIsNumeric) AndAlso secondIsNumeric

contracts.whole_body:
Public Shared Function HasNumericMatrixHeader(lastRow As Integer, columns As Integer, blank As Func(Of Integer, Integer, Boolean), numeric As Func(Of Integer, Integer, Boolean)) As Boolean
        If lastRow < 1 Then Return False

        Dim cols As Integer = columns
        Dim anyNonBlankNonNumericFirstRow As Boolean = False
        Dim anyNumericFirstRow As Boolean = False
        For j As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
            If blank(0, j) Then Continue For

            If numeric(0, j) Then
                anyNumericFirstRow = True
            Else
                anyNonBlankNonNumericFirstRow = True
            End If
        Next

        ' A real numeric-matrix header should look like labels, not like a data row
        ' with one or more missing numeric values. This prevents explicit data ranges
        ' whose first observation has missing values from being shortened before row-wise
        ' complete-case filtering aligns y, x, subject, and visit.
        If Not anyNonBlankNonNumericFirstRow Then Return False
        If anyNumericFirstRow Then Return False

        For j As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
            If Not numeric(1, j) Then
                Return False
            End If
        Next

        Return True
        End Function

Public Shared Function HasNumericMatrixHeader(lastRow As Integer, columns As Integer, blank As Func(Of Integer, Integer, Boolean), numeric As Func(Of Integer, Integer, Boolean)) As Boolean
        If lastRow < 1 Then Return False

        Dim cols As Integer = columns
        Dim anyNonBlankNonNumericFirstRow As Boolean = False
        Dim anyNumericFirstRow As Boolean = False
        For j As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
            If blank(0, j) Then Continue For

            If numeric(0, j) Then
                anyNumericFirstRow = True
            Else
                anyNonBlankNonNumericFirstRow = True
            End If
        Next

        ' A real numeric-matrix header should look like labels, not like a data row
        ' with one or more missing numeric values. This prevents explicit data ranges
        ' whose first observation has missing values from being shortened before row-wise
        ' complete-case filtering aligns y, x, subject, and visit.
        If Not anyNonBlankNonNumericFirstRow Then Return False
        If anyNumericFirstRow Then Return False

        For j As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
            If Not numeric(1, j) Then
                Return False
            End If
        Next

        Return True
        End Function

contracts.whole_body:
Public Shared Function TryBinaryPrepared(value As Double?, logicalValue As Boolean?, ByRef result As Integer) As Boolean
            If value.HasValue Then
                Dim integerValue As Integer = CInt(Math.Truncate(value.Value))
                If integerValue = 0 OrElse integerValue = 1 Then
                    result = integerValue
                    Return True
                End If
                Return False
            End If
            If logicalValue.HasValue Then
                result = If(logicalValue.Value, 1, 0)
                Return True
            End If
            Return False
        End Function

contracts.whole_body:
Public Shared Function Normalize(data As PreferenceData) As PreferenceResult
            If data Is Nothing Then Return New PreferenceResult(Defaults(), PreferenceStatus.Defaulted,
                PreferencePersistence.SessionOnly, {"preferences.missing"})
            If data.SchemaVersion <> CurrentSchemaVersion Then Return New PreferenceResult(Defaults(),
                PreferenceStatus.UnsupportedVersion, PreferencePersistence.SessionOnly, {"preferences.version.unsupported"})
            Dim codes As New List(Of String)()
            Dim runtime As New AnalysisDefaultsOptions(data.DefaultAlpha.GetValueOrDefault(0.05),
                data.DefaultRandomSeed.GetValueOrDefault(AnalysisDefaultsOptions.NoExplicitRandomSeed))
            If Not data.DefaultAlpha.HasValue Then
                codes.Add("preferences.alpha.missing")
            ElseIf data.DefaultAlpha.Value <> runtime.DefaultAlpha Then
                codes.Add("preferences.alpha.defaulted")
            End If
            If Not data.DefaultRandomSeed.HasValue Then
                codes.Add("preferences.seed.missing")
            ElseIf data.DefaultRandomSeed.Value <> runtime.DefaultRandomSeed Then
                codes.Add("preferences.seed.defaulted")
            End If
            If Not data.TraceEnabled.HasValue Then codes.Add("preferences.trace.missing")
            Dim display As New PValuePresentationSettings()
            If data.PValues Is Nothing Then
                codes.Add("preferences.display.missing")
            Else
                If data.PValues.DecimalPlaces.HasValue Then
                    display.DecimalPlaces = data.PValues.DecimalPlaces.Value
                Else
                    codes.Add("preferences.digits.missing")
                End If
                If data.PValues.SmallValueDisplay.HasValue Then
                    display.SmallValueDisplay = data.PValues.SmallValueDisplay.Value
                Else
                    codes.Add("preferences.mode.missing")
                End If
                display.UseUpperBound = data.PValues.UseUpperBound.GetValueOrDefault(True)
                If Not data.PValues.UseUpperBound.HasValue Then codes.Add("preferences.upper-bound.missing")
                display.EnsureDefaults()
                If data.PValues.DecimalPlaces.HasValue AndAlso data.PValues.DecimalPlaces.Value <> display.DecimalPlaces Then codes.Add("preferences.digits.defaulted")
                If data.PValues.SmallValueDisplay.HasValue AndAlso data.PValues.SmallValueDisplay.Value <> display.SmallValueDisplay Then codes.Add("preferences.mode.defaulted")
            End If
            Return New PreferenceResult(New PreferenceSnapshot(runtime.DefaultAlpha, runtime.DefaultRandomSeed,
                data.TraceEnabled.GetValueOrDefault(True), display), If(codes.Count = 0, PreferenceStatus.Loaded,
                PreferenceStatus.Normalized), PreferencePersistence.SessionOnly, codes)

Public Shared Function Normalize(data As PreferenceData) As PreferenceResult
            If data Is Nothing Then Return New PreferenceResult(Defaults(), PreferenceStatus.Defaulted,
                PreferencePersistence.SessionOnly, {"preferences.missing"})
            If data.SchemaVersion <> CurrentSchemaVersion Then Return New PreferenceResult(Defaults(),
                PreferenceStatus.UnsupportedVersion, PreferencePersistence.SessionOnly, {"preferences.version.unsupported"})
            Dim codes As New List(Of String)()
            Dim runtime As New AnalysisDefaultsOptions(data.DefaultAlpha.GetValueOrDefault(0.05),
                data.DefaultRandomSeed.GetValueOrDefault(AnalysisDefaultsOptions.NoExplicitRandomSeed))
            If Not data.DefaultAlpha.HasValue Then
                codes.Add("preferences.alpha.missing")
            ElseIf data.DefaultAlpha.Value <> runtime.DefaultAlpha Then
                codes.Add("preferences.alpha.defaulted")
            End If
            If Not data.DefaultRandomSeed.HasValue Then
                codes.Add("preferences.seed.missing")
            ElseIf data.DefaultRandomSeed.Value <> runtime.DefaultRandomSeed Then
                codes.Add("preferences.seed.defaulted")
            End If
            If Not data.TraceEnabled.HasValue Then codes.Add("preferences.trace.missing")
            Dim display As New PValuePresentationSettings()
            If data.PValues Is Nothing Then
                codes.Add("preferences.display.missing")
            Else
                If data.PValues.DecimalPlaces.HasValue Then
                    display.DecimalPlaces = data.PValues.DecimalPlaces.Value
                Else
                    codes.Add("preferences.digits.missing")
                End If
                If data.PValues.SmallValueDisplay.HasValue Then
                    display.SmallValueDisplay = data.PValues.SmallValueDisplay.Value

                    codes.Add("preferences.mode.missing")

                If data.PValues.SmallValueDisplay.HasValue AndAlso data.PValues.SmallValueDisplay.Value <> display.SmallValueDisplay Then codes.Add("preferences.mode.defaulted")
            End If
            Return New PreferenceResult(New PreferenceSnapshot(runtime.DefaultAlpha, runtime.DefaultRandomSeed,
                data.TraceEnabled.GetValueOrDefault(True), display), If(codes.Count = 0, PreferenceStatus.Loaded,
                PreferenceStatus.Normalized), PreferencePersistence.SessionOnly, codes)

contracts.whole_body:
Private Shared Sub ValidatePositive(value As Double, maximum As Double, name As String)
            If Double.IsNaN(value) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(value) OrElse value <= 0 OrElse value > maximum Then
                Throw New ArgumentOutOfRangeException(name, "A finite positive bounded budget is required.")
            End If
        End Sub

                       Optional cancellation As CancellationToken = Nothing,
                       Optional elapsedMilliseconds As Func(Of Double) = Nothing)

            _elapsedMilliseconds = If(elapsedMilliseconds, Function() timer.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds)
            Checkpoint()

Public Sub Checkpoint()
            _cancellation.ThrowIfCancellationRequested()
            Dim elapsed As Double = _elapsedMilliseconds()
            If Double.IsNaN(elapsed) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(elapsed) OrElse elapsed < _lastElapsed Then
                Throw New ArgumentException("Elapsed time must be finite, nonnegative and monotonic.")
            End If
            _lastElapsed = elapsed
            If elapsed > _limits.TimeBudgetMilliseconds Then
                Reject("input.time-budget", "timeBudgetMilliseconds", elapsed, _limits.TimeBudgetMilliseconds)
            End If
        End Sub

Public Sub AddRange(rows As Long, columns As Long)
            Checkpoint()
            If rows < 1 OrElse columns < 1 Then
                Reject("input.dimensions", "ranges", rows.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) & " x " & columns.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), "positive dimensions")
            End If
            If rows > Long.MaxValue \ columns Then
                Reject("input.cell-overflow", "ranges", rows.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) & " x " & columns.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), Long.MaxValue)
            End If
            Dim cells As Long = rows * columns
            If cells > _limits.MaxRangeCells Then Reject("input.range-cells", "maxRangeCells", cells, _limits.MaxRangeCells)
            If RangeCount >= _limits.MaxRanges Then Reject("input.range-count", "maxRanges", CLng(RangeCount) + 1, _limits.MaxRanges)
            If cells > _limits.MaxTotalCells - TotalCells Then
                Reject("input.total-cells", "maxTotalCells", CDec(TotalCells) + CDec(cells), _limits.MaxTotalCells)
            End If
            Dim total As Long = TotalCells + cells
            Dim estimate As Double = CDbl(total) * _limits.EstimatedBytesPerCell
            If estimate > _limits.MaxEstimatedBytes Then Reject("input.estimated-bytes", "maxEstimatedBytes", estimate, _limits.MaxEstimatedBytes)
            _TotalCells = total
            _RangeCount += 1
        End Sub

Public Sub New(code As String, severity As SpreadsheetValidationSeverity,
                       message As String, fieldPath As String,
                       Optional selectedRow As Integer = 0, Optional selectedColumn As Integer = 0,
                       Optional worksheetRow As Integer = 0, Optional worksheetColumn As Integer = 0)
            If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(code) Then Throw New ArgumentException("An issue code is required.", NameOf(code))
            If selectedRow < 0 OrElse selectedColumn < 0 OrElse worksheetRow < 0 OrElse worksheetColumn < 0 Then
                Throw New ArgumentOutOfRangeException(NameOf(selectedRow), "Validation coordinates must be nonnegative.")
            End If
            Me.Code = code
            Me.Severity = severity
            Me.Message = If(message, String.Empty)
            Me.FieldPath = If(fieldPath, String.Empty)
            Me.SelectedRow = selectedRow
            Me.SelectedColumn = selectedColumn
            Me.WorksheetRow = worksheetRow
            Me.WorksheetColumn = worksheetColumn

contracts.whole_body:
Public Shared Function SpreadsheetError(token As String, Optional nativeCode As Integer? = Nothing,
                                                Optional safeDetail As String = Nothing) As OutputCell
            If token Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(token))
            Dim kind As OutputErrorKind
            Dim code As String
            Select Case token
                Case "#NULL!" : kind = OutputErrorKind.NullIntersection : code = "spreadsheet.null"
                Case "#DIV/0!" : kind = OutputErrorKind.DivisionByZero : code = "spreadsheet.division-by-zero"
                Case "#VALUE!" : kind = OutputErrorKind.InvalidValue : code = "spreadsheet.value"
                Case "#REF!" : kind = OutputErrorKind.InvalidReference : code = "spreadsheet.reference"
                Case "#NAME?" : kind = OutputErrorKind.UnknownName : code = "spreadsheet.name"
                Case "#NUM!" : kind = OutputErrorKind.InvalidNumber : code = "spreadsheet.number"
                Case "#N/A" : kind = OutputErrorKind.NotAvailable : code = "spreadsheet.not-available"
                Case "#GETTING_DATA" : kind = OutputErrorKind.GettingData : code = "spreadsheet.getting-data"
                Case Else : kind = OutputErrorKind.Unknown : code = "spreadsheet.unknown"
            End Select
            Return New OutputCell(OutputCellKind.Error, errorKind:=kind, errorCode:=code,
                                  originalError:=token, nativeCode:=nativeCode, safeDetail:=safeDetail)
        End Function

            If token Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(token))
            Dim kind As OutputErrorKind
            Dim code As String
            Select Case token
                Case "#NULL!" : kind = OutputErrorKind.NullIntersection : code = "spreadsheet.null"
                Case "#DIV/0!" : kind = OutputErrorKind.DivisionByZero : code = "spreadsheet.division-by-zero"
                Case "#VALUE!" : kind = OutputErrorKind.InvalidValue : code = "spreadsheet.value"
                Case "#REF!" : kind = OutputErrorKind.InvalidReference : code = "spreadsheet.reference"
                Case "#NAME?" : kind = OutputErrorKind.UnknownName : code = "spreadsheet.name"
                Case "#NUM!" : kind = OutputErrorKind.InvalidNumber : code = "spreadsheet.number"
                Case "#N/A" : kind = OutputErrorKind.NotAvailable : code = "spreadsheet.not-available"
                Case "#GETTING_DATA" : kind = OutputErrorKind.GettingData : code = "spreadsheet.getting-data"
                Case Else : kind = OutputErrorKind.Unknown : code = "spreadsheet.unknown"
            End Select
            Return New OutputCell(OutputCellKind.Error, errorKind:=kind, errorCode:=code,
                                  originalError:=token, nativeCode:=nativeCode, safeDetail:=safeDetail)
        End Function

Public Shared Function BuildBinaryCrosstabUdfOutput(summary As BinaryClassificationSummary, missingValue As Object,
                                                     Optional includeHeader As Boolean = True) As Object
            Dim rowOffset As Integer = If(includeHeader, 1, 0)
            Dim outRows As Integer = rowOffset + 4
            Dim out(outRows - 1, 3) As Object

            If includeHeader Then
                out(0, 0) = "Observed \ Predicted"
                out(0, 1) = 0
                out(0, 2) = 1
                out(0, 3) = "Recall %"
            End If

            out(rowOffset + 0, 0) = 0
            out(rowOffset + 0, 1) = summary.TN
            out(rowOffset + 0, 2) = summary.FP
            out(rowOffset + 0, 3) = PercentOrMissingValue(summary.Specificity, missingValue)

            out(rowOffset + 1, 0) = 1
            out(rowOffset + 1, 1) = summary.FN
            out(rowOffset + 1, 2) = summary.TP
            out(rowOffset + 1, 3) = PercentOrMissingValue(summary.Sensitivity, missingValue)

            out(rowOffset + 2, 0) = "Precision % / Overall"
            out(rowOffset + 2, 1) = PercentOrMissingValue(summary.NPV, missingValue)
            out(rowOffset + 2, 2) = PercentOrMissingValue(summary.Precision, missingValue)
            out(rowOffset + 2, 3) = PercentOrMissingValue(summary.Accuracy, missingValue)

            out(rowOffset + 3, 0) = "Threshold / Balanced accuracy"
            out(rowOffset + 3, 1) = summary.Threshold
            out(rowOffset + 3, 2) = PercentOrMissingValue(summary.BalancedAccuracy, missingValue)
            out(rowOffset + 3, 3) = PercentOrMissingValue(summary.YoudenJ, missingValue)

            Return UdfSpillPreparation38.NormalizeBlanks(out)
        End Function

                                                     Optional includeHeader As Boolean = True) As Object
            Dim rowOffset As Integer = If(includeHeader, 1, 0)
            Dim outRows As Integer = rowOffset + 4
            Dim out(outRows - 1, 3) As Object

            If includeHeader Then
                out(0, 0) = "Observed \ Predicted"
                out(0, 1) = 0
                out(0, 2) = 1
                out(0, 3) = "Recall %"
            End If

            out(rowOffset + 0, 0) = 0
            out(rowOffset + 0, 1) = summary.TN
            out(rowOffset + 0, 2) = summary.FP
            out(rowOffset + 0, 3) = PercentOrMissingValue(summary.Specificity, missingValue)

            out(rowOffset + 1, 0) = 1
            out(rowOffset + 1, 1) = summary.FN
            out(rowOffset + 1, 2) = summary.TP
            out(rowOffset + 1, 3) = PercentOrMissingValue(summary.Sensitivity, missingValue)

            out(rowOffset + 2, 0) = "Precision % / Overall"
            out(rowOffset + 2, 1) = PercentOrMissingValue(summary.NPV, missingValue)
            out(rowOffset + 2, 2) = PercentOrMissingValue(summary.Precision, missingValue)
            out(rowOffset + 2, 3) = PercentOrMissingValue(summary.Accuracy, missingValue)

            out(rowOffset + 3, 0) = "Threshold / Balanced accuracy"
            out(rowOffset + 3, 1) = summary.Threshold
            out(rowOffset + 3, 2) = PercentOrMissingValue(summary.BalancedAccuracy, missingValue)
            out(rowOffset + 3, 3) = PercentOrMissingValue(summary.YoudenJ, missingValue)

            Return UdfSpillPreparation38.NormalizeBlanks(out)
        End Function

Public Shared Function BuildThresholdTableUdfOutput(rows As IList(Of BinaryThresholdRow), missingValue As Object,
                                                     Optional includeHeader As Boolean = True) As Object
            If rows Is Nothing OrElse rows.Count = 0 Then Return missingValue

            Dim rowOffset As Integer = If(includeHeader, 1, 0)
            Dim outRows As Integer = rowOffset + rows.Count
            Dim out(outRows - 1, 13) As Object

            If includeHeader Then
                out(0, 0) = "Threshold"
                out(0, 1) = "TP"
                out(0, 2) = "FP"
                out(0, 3) = "TN"
                out(0, 4) = "FN"
                out(0, 5) = "Sensitivity %"
                out(0, 6) = "Specificity %"
                out(0, 7) = "Precision %"
                out(0, 8) = "Recall %"
                out(0, 9) = "NPV %"
                out(0, 10) = "Accuracy %"
                out(0, 11) = "BalancedAccuracy %"
                out(0, 12) = "YoudenJ %"
                out(0, 13) = "F1 %"
            End If

            For i As Integer = 0 To rows.Count - 1
                Dim r As BinaryThresholdRow = rows(i)
                Dim rr As Integer = rowOffset + i
                out(rr, 0) = r.Threshold
                out(rr, 1) = r.TP
                out(rr, 2) = r.FP
                out(rr, 3) = r.TN
                out(rr, 4) = r.FN
                out(rr, 5) = PercentOrMissingValue(r.Sensitivity, missingValue)
                out(rr, 6) = PercentOrMissingValue(r.Specificity, missingValue)
                out(rr, 7) = PercentOrMissingValue(r.Precision, missingValue)
                out(rr, 8) = PercentOrMissingValue(r.Recall, missingValue)
                out(rr, 9) = PercentOrMissingValue(r.NPV, missingValue)
                out(rr, 10) = PercentOrMissingValue(r.Accuracy, missingValue)
                out(rr, 11) = PercentOrMissingValue(r.BalancedAccuracy, missingValue)
                out(rr, 12) = PercentOrMissingValue(r.YoudenJ, missingValue)
                out(rr, 13) = PercentOrMissingValue(r.F1, missingValue)
            Next

            Return UdfSpillPreparation38.NormalizeBlanks(out)
        End Function

Public Shared Function BuildThresholdTableUdfOutput(rows As IList(Of BinaryThresholdRow), missingValue As Object,
                                                     Optional includeHeader As Boolean = True) As Object
            If rows Is Nothing OrElse rows.Count = 0 Then Return missingValue

            Dim rowOffset As Integer = If(includeHeader, 1, 0)
            Dim outRows As Integer = rowOffset + rows.Count
            Dim out(outRows - 1, 13) As Object

            If includeHeader Then
                out(0, 0) = "Threshold"
                out(0, 1) = "TP"
                out(0, 2) = "FP"
                out(0, 3) = "TN"
                out(0, 4) = "FN"
                out(0, 5) = "Sensitivity %"
                out(0, 6) = "Specificity %"
                out(0, 7) = "Precision %"
                out(0, 8) = "Recall %"
                out(0, 9) = "NPV %"
                out(0, 10) = "Accuracy %"
                out(0, 11) = "BalancedAccuracy %"
                out(0, 12) = "YoudenJ %"
                out(0, 13) = "F1 %"
            End If

            For i As Integer = 0 To rows.Count - 1
                Dim r As BinaryThresholdRow = rows(i)
                Dim rr As Integer = rowOffset + i
                out(rr, 0) = r.Threshold
                out(rr, 1) = r.TP
                out(rr, 2) = r.FP
                out(rr, 3) = r.TN
                out(rr, 4) = r.FN
                out(rr, 5) = PercentOrMissingValue(r.Sensitivity, missingValue)
                out(rr, 6) = PercentOrMissingValue(r.Specificity, missingValue)
                out(rr, 7) = PercentOrMissingValue(r.Precision, missingValue)
                out(rr, 8) = PercentOrMissingValue(r.Recall, missingValue)
                out(rr, 9) = PercentOrMissingValue(r.NPV, missingValue)
                out(rr, 10) = PercentOrMissingValue(r.Accuracy, missingValue)
                out(rr, 11) = PercentOrMissingValue(r.BalancedAccuracy, missingValue)
                out(rr, 12) = PercentOrMissingValue(r.YoudenJ, missingValue)
                out(rr, 13) = PercentOrMissingValue(r.F1, missingValue)
            Next

            Return UdfSpillPreparation38.NormalizeBlanks(out)
        End Function

Public Shared Function BuildCalibrationTableUdfOutput(rows As IList(Of CalibrationBinSummary), missingValue As Object,
                                                       Optional includeHeader As Boolean = True) As Object
            If rows Is Nothing OrElse rows.Count = 0 Then Return missingValue

            Dim rowOffset As Integer = If(includeHeader, 1, 0)
            Dim outRows As Integer = rowOffset + rows.Count
            Dim out(outRows - 1, 5) As Object

            If includeHeader Then
                out(0, 0) = "Bin"
                out(0, 1) = "N"
                out(0, 2) = "MeanPredicted"
                out(0, 3) = "ObservedRate"
                out(0, 4) = "LowerCI"
                out(0, 5) = "UpperCI"
            End If

            For i As Integer = 0 To rows.Count - 1
                Dim r As CalibrationBinSummary = rows(i)
                Dim rr As Integer = rowOffset + i
                out(rr, 0) = r.BinIndex
                out(rr, 1) = r.N
                out(rr, 2) = r.MeanPredicted
                out(rr, 3) = r.ObservedRate
                out(rr, 4) = r.LowerCI
                out(rr, 5) = r.UpperCI
            Next

            Return UdfSpillPreparation38.NormalizeBlanks(out)
        End Function

Public Shared Function BuildCalibrationTableUdfOutput(rows As IList(Of CalibrationBinSummary), missingValue As Object,
                                                       Optional includeHeader As Boolean = True) As Object
            If rows Is Nothing OrElse rows.Count = 0 Then Return missingValue

            Dim rowOffset As Integer = If(includeHeader, 1, 0)
            Dim outRows As Integer = rowOffset + rows.Count
            Dim out(outRows - 1, 5) As Object

            If includeHeader Then
                out(0, 0) = "Bin"
                out(0, 1) = "N"
                out(0, 2) = "MeanPredicted"
                out(0, 3) = "ObservedRate"
                out(0, 4) = "LowerCI"
                out(0, 5) = "UpperCI"
            End If

            For i As Integer = 0 To rows.Count - 1
                Dim r As CalibrationBinSummary = rows(i)
                Dim rr As Integer = rowOffset + i
                out(rr, 0) = r.BinIndex
                out(rr, 1) = r.N
                out(rr, 2) = r.MeanPredicted
                out(rr, 3) = r.ObservedRate
                out(rr, 4) = r.LowerCI
                out(rr, 5) = r.UpperCI
            Next

            Return UdfSpillPreparation38.NormalizeBlanks(out)
        End Function

contracts.whole_body:
Public Shared Function BuildBrierScoreUdfOutput(score As Double, missingValue As Object,
                                                 Optional n As Double = Double.NaN,
                                                 Optional eventRate As Double = Double.NaN,
                                                 Optional includeHeader As Boolean = True) As Object
            Dim totalRows As Integer = 1
            If Not Double.IsNaN(n) Then totalRows += 1
            If Not Double.IsNaN(eventRate) Then totalRows += 1

            Dim rowOffset As Integer = If(includeHeader, 1, 0)
            Dim outRows As Integer = rowOffset + totalRows
            Dim out(outRows - 1, 1) As Object

            If includeHeader Then
                out(0, 0) = "Item"
                out(0, 1) = "Value"
            End If

            Dim r As Integer = rowOffset
            out(r, 0) = "BrierScore"
            out(r, 1) = score
            r += 1

            If Not Double.IsNaN(n) Then
                out(r, 0) = "N"
                out(r, 1) = n
                r += 1
            End If

            If Not Double.IsNaN(eventRate) Then
                out(r, 0) = "EventRate"
                out(r, 1) = eventRate
            End If

            Return UdfSpillPreparation38.NormalizeBlanks(out)
        End Function

Public Shared Function BuildBrierScoreUdfOutput(score As Double, missingValue As Object,
                                                 Optional n As Double = Double.NaN,
                                                 Optional eventRate As Double = Double.NaN,
                                                 Optional includeHeader As Boolean = True) As Object
            Dim totalRows As Integer = 1
            If Not Double.IsNaN(n) Then totalRows += 1
            If Not Double.IsNaN(eventRate) Then totalRows += 1

            Dim rowOffset As Integer = If(includeHeader, 1, 0)
            Dim outRows As Integer = rowOffset + totalRows
            Dim out(outRows - 1, 1) As Object

            If includeHeader Then
                out(0, 0) = "Item"
                out(0, 1) = "Value"
            End If

            Dim r As Integer = rowOffset
            out(r, 0) = "BrierScore"
            out(r, 1) = score
            r += 1

            If Not Double.IsNaN(n) Then
                out(r, 0) = "N"
                out(r, 1) = n
                r += 1
            End If

            If Not Double.IsNaN(eventRate) Then
                out(r, 0) = "EventRate"
                out(r, 1) = eventRate
            End If

            Return UdfSpillPreparation38.NormalizeBlanks(out)
        End Function

Private Shared Function PercentOrMissingValue(value As Double, missingValue As Object) As Object
            If Double.IsNaN(value) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(value) Then Return missingValue
            Return 100.0R * value
        End Function

Public Shared Function BuildCoxSummaryTable(hdr As Boolean, p As Integer, varNames As String(), result As CoxResult, robust As Boolean, zCrit As Double, ciPct As String, expForDisplay As Func(Of Double, Object)) As Object(,)
            Dim rows As Integer = If(hdr, p + 1, p)
            Dim out(rows - 1, 7) As Object

            Dim r0 As Integer = 0
            If hdr Then
                out(0, 0) = "Variable"
                out(0, 1) = "Coef"
                out(0, 2) = "SE"
                out(0, 3) = "Z"
                out(0, 4) = "P-value"
                out(0, 5) = "HR"
                out(0, 6) = "HR " & ciPct & " LCL"
                out(0, 7) = "HR " & ciPct & " UCL"
                r0 = 1
            End If

            For i As Integer = 0 To p - 1
                Dim beta As Double = result.Coefficients(i)
                Dim se As Double
                If robust AndAlso result.VarCovRobust IsNot Nothing AndAlso result.VarCovRobust.GetLength(0) = p Then
                    se = Math.Sqrt(result.VarCovRobust(i, i))
                Else
                    se = Math.Sqrt(result.VarCov(i, i))
                End If

                Dim z As Double = beta / se
                Dim pv As Double = 2.0 * distributions.PNorm(-Math.Abs(z))
                Dim hr As Object = expForDisplay(beta)
                Dim lcl As Object = expForDisplay(beta - zCrit * se)
                Dim ucl As Object = expForDisplay(beta + zCrit * se)

                out(r0 + i, 0) = varNames(i)
                out(r0 + i, 1) = beta
                out(r0 + i, 2) = se
                out(r0 + i, 3) = z
                out(r0 + i, 4) = pv
                out(r0 + i, 5) = hr
                out(r0 + i, 6) = lcl
                out(r0 + i, 7) = ucl
            Next
            Return out
        End Function

Public Shared Function BuildCoxSummaryTable(hdr As Boolean, p As Integer, varNames As String(), result As CoxResult, robust As Boolean, zCrit As Double, ciPct As String, expForDisplay As Func(Of Double, Object)) As Object(,)
            Dim rows As Integer = If(hdr, p + 1, p)
            Dim out(rows - 1, 7) As Object

            Dim r0 As Integer = 0
            If hdr Then
                out(0, 0) = "Variable"
                out(0, 1) = "Coef"
                out(0, 2) = "SE"
                out(0, 3) = "Z"
                out(0, 4) = "P-value"
                out(0, 5) = "HR"
                out(0, 6) = "HR " & ciPct & " LCL"
                out(0, 7) = "HR " & ciPct & " UCL"
                r0 = 1
            End If

            For i As Integer = 0 To p - 1
                Dim beta As Double = result.Coefficients(i)
                Dim se As Double
                If robust AndAlso result.VarCovRobust IsNot Nothing AndAlso result.VarCovRobust.GetLength(0) = p Then
                    se = Math.Sqrt(result.VarCovRobust(i, i))
                Else
                    se = Math.Sqrt(result.VarCov(i, i))
                End If

                Dim z As Double = beta / se
                Dim pv As Double = 2.0 * distributions.PNorm(-Math.Abs(z))
                Dim hr As Object = expForDisplay(beta)
                Dim lcl As Object = expForDisplay(beta - zCrit * se)
                Dim ucl As Object = expForDisplay(beta + zCrit * se)

                out(r0 + i, 0) = varNames(i)
                out(r0 + i, 1) = beta
                out(r0 + i, 2) = se
                out(r0 + i, 3) = z
                out(r0 + i, 4) = pv
                out(r0 + i, 5) = hr
                out(r0 + i, 6) = lcl
                out(r0 + i, 7) = ucl
            Next
            Return out
        End Function

Public Shared Function BuildCoxTestsTable(hdr As Boolean, p As Integer, result As CoxResult, lr As Object, lrP As Object, wald As Object, waldP As Object, unavailable As Object) As Object(,)
            Dim nRows As Integer = If(hdr, 7, 5)
            Dim out(nRows - 1, 3) As Object
            Dim r As Integer = 0

            If hdr Then
                out(0, 0) = "Item"
                out(0, 1) = "Value"
                out(0, 2) = "df"
                out(0, 3) = "P-value"
                r = 1
            End If

            out(r + 0, 0) = "Likelihood-ratio chi-square"
            out(r + 0, 1) = lr
            out(r + 0, 2) = p
            out(r + 0, 3) = lrP

            out(r + 1, 0) = "Wald chi-square"
            out(r + 1, 1) = wald
            out(r + 1, 2) = p

Public Shared Function BuildCoxTestsTable(hdr As Boolean, p As Integer, result As CoxResult, lr As Object, lrP As Object, wald As Object, waldP As Object, unavailable As Object) As Object(,)
            Dim nRows As Integer = If(hdr, 7, 5)
            Dim out(nRows - 1, 3) As Object
            Dim r As Integer = 0

            If hdr Then
                out(0, 0) = "Item"
                out(0, 1) = "Value"
                out(0, 2) = "df"
                out(0, 3) = "P-value"
                r = 1
            End If

            out(r + 0, 0) = "Likelihood-ratio chi-square"
            out(r + 0, 1) = lr
            out(r + 0, 2) = p
            out(r + 0, 3) = lrP

            out(r + 1, 0) = "Wald chi-square"
            out(r + 1, 1) = wald
            out(r + 1, 2) = p
            out(r + 1, 3) = waldP

            out(r + 2, 0) = "Log-likelihood (null)"
            out(r + 2, 1) = If(Not Double.IsNaN(result.LogLikelihoodNull) AndAlso Not Double.IsInfinity(result.LogLikelihoodNull), CType(result.LogLikelihoodNull, Object), unavailable)
            out(r + 2, 2) = ""
            out(r + 2, 3) = ""

            out(r + 3, 0) = "Log-likelihood (fitted)"
            out(r + 3, 1) = If(Not Double.IsNaN(result.LogLikelihood) AndAlso Not Double.IsInfinity(result.LogLikelihood), CType(result.LogLikelihood, Object), unavailable)
            out(r + 3, 2) = ""
            out(r + 3, 3) = ""

            out(r + 4, 0) = "Iterations"
            out(r + 4, 1) = result.Iterations
            out(r + 4, 2) = ""
            out(r + 4, 3) = ""

            If hdr Then
                out(r + 5, 0) = "Converged"
                out(r + 5, 1) = result.Converged
                out(r + 5, 2) = ""
                out(r + 5, 3) = ""
            End If
            Return out
        End Function

Public Shared Function BuildCoxResidualTable(d As Dictionary(Of Integer, Double()), keys As List(Of Integer), width As Integer, varNames As String(), rt As ResidualType) As Object(,)
            Dim out(keys.Count, width) As Object
            out(0, 0) = "Row ID"
            If width = 1 Then
                out(0, 1) = CoxUDFsMetadata38.ResidualLabel(rt)
            Else
                For j As Integer = 0 To width - 1
                    out(0, j + 1) = If(j < varNames.Length, varNames(j), "V" & (j + 1).ToString())
                Next
            End If
            For i As Integer = 0 To keys.Count - 1
                out(i + 1, 0) = keys(i)
                Dim vals = d(keys(i))
                For j As Integer = 0 To vals.Length - 1
                    out(i + 1, j + 1) = vals(j)
                Next
            Next
            Return out
        End Function

Public Shared Function BuildCoxResidualTable(d As Dictionary(Of Integer, Double()), keys As List(Of Integer), width As Integer, varNames As String(), rt As ResidualType) As Object(,)
            Dim out(keys.Count, width) As Object
            out(0, 0) = "Row ID"
            If width = 1 Then
                out(0, 1) = CoxUDFsMetadata38.ResidualLabel(rt)
            Else
                For j As Integer = 0 To width - 1
                    out(0, j + 1) = If(j < varNames.Length, varNames(j), "V" & (j + 1).ToString())
                Next
            End If
            For i As Integer = 0 To keys.Count - 1
                out(i + 1, 0) = keys(i)
                Dim vals = d(keys(i))
                For j As Integer = 0 To vals.Length - 1
                    out(i + 1, j + 1) = vals(j)
                Next
            Next
            Return out
        End Function

contracts.whole_body:
Public Shared Function CreateCoxBaselineTable(total As Integer, tp As String) As Object(,)
            Dim cols As Integer = If(LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(tp, "survival") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(tp, "cumhaz"), 3, 4)
            Dim out(total - 1, cols - 1) As Object
            If cols = 4 Then
                out(0, 0) = "Stratum" : out(0, 1) = "Time" : out(0, 2) = "Survival" : out(0, 3) = "CumHazard"
            Else
                out(0, 0) = "Stratum" : out(0, 1) = "Time" : out(0, 2) = If(LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(tp, "survival"), "Survival", "CumHazard")
            End If
            Return out
        End Function

contracts.whole_body:
Public Shared Function BuildGeeSummaryTable(beta As Double(), se As Double(), names As String(), hdr As Boolean, alphaValue As Double) As Object(,)
            Dim outRows As Integer = If(hdr, beta.Length + 1, beta.Length)
            Dim out(outRows - 1, 7) As Object
            Dim zCrit As Double = distributions.ZCritTwoSided(alphaValue)
            Dim ciLabel As String = (100.0R * (1.0R - alphaValue)).ToString("0.##", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) & "%"
            Dim r0 As Integer = 0

            If hdr Then
                out(0, 0) = "Parameter"
                out(0, 1) = "Type"
                out(0, 2) = "Coef"
                out(0, 3) = "SE"
                out(0, 4) = "Z"
                out(0, 5) = "P-value"
                out(0, 6) = ciLabel & " CI Lower"
                out(0, 7) = ciLabel & " CI Upper"
                r0 = 1
            End If

            For i As Integer = 0 To beta.Length - 1
                Dim z As Double = If(se(i) > 0.0R, beta(i) / se(i), Double.NaN)
                Dim pv As Double = If(se(i) > 0.0R, 2.0R * distributions.PNorm(-Math.Abs(z)), Double.NaN)

                out(r0 + i, 0) = names(i)
                out(r0 + i, 1) = If(i = 0, "Intercept", "Slope")
                out(r0 + i, 2) = beta(i)
                out(r0 + i, 3) = se(i)
                out(r0 + i, 4) = z
                out(r0 + i, 5) = pv
                out(r0 + i, 6) = beta(i) - zCrit * se(i)
                out(r0 + i, 7) = beta(i) + zCrit * se(i)
            Next
            Return out
        End Function

Public Shared Function BuildGeeSummaryTable(beta As Double(), se As Double(), names As String(), hdr As Boolean, alphaValue As Double) As Object(,)
            Dim outRows As Integer = If(hdr, beta.Length + 1, beta.Length)
            Dim out(outRows - 1, 7) As Object
            Dim zCrit As Double = distributions.ZCritTwoSided(alphaValue)
            Dim ciLabel As String = (100.0R * (1.0R - alphaValue)).ToString("0.##", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) & "%"
            Dim r0 As Integer = 0

            If hdr Then
                out(0, 0) = "Parameter"
                out(0, 1) = "Type"
                out(0, 2) = "Coef"
                out(0, 3) = "SE"
                out(0, 4) = "Z"
                out(0, 5) = "P-value"
                out(0, 6) = ciLabel & " CI Lower"
                out(0, 7) = ciLabel & " CI Upper"
                r0 = 1
            End If

            For i As Integer = 0 To beta.Length - 1
                Dim z As Double = If(se(i) > 0.0R, beta(i) / se(i), Double.NaN)
                Dim pv As Double = If(se(i) > 0.0R, 2.0R * distributions.PNorm(-Math.Abs(z)), Double.NaN)

                out(r0 + i, 0) = names(i)
                out(r0 + i, 1) = If(i = 0, "Intercept", "Slope")
                out(r0 + i, 2) = beta(i)
                out(r0 + i, 3) = se(i)
                out(r0 + i, 4) = z
                out(r0 + i, 5) = pv
                out(r0 + i, 6) = beta(i) - zCrit * se(i)
                out(r0 + i, 7) = beta(i) + zCrit * se(i)
            Next
            Return out
        End Function

Public Shared Function MaterializeGeeRows(rows As List(Of Object()), includeHeader As Boolean, headers As String(), unavailable As Object) As Object
            If rows Is Nothing Then Return unavailable

            Dim colCount As Integer = If(headers Is Nothing, 0, headers.Length)
            If colCount = 0 AndAlso rows.Count > 0 Then
                colCount = rows(0).Length
            End If
            If colCount < 1 Then Return unavailable

            Dim outRows As Integer = rows.Count + If(includeHeader, 1, 0)
            Dim out(outRows - 1, colCount - 1) As Object
            Dim r0 As Integer = 0

            If includeHeader Then
                For j As Integer = 0 To colCount - 1
                    out(0, j) = headers(j)
                Next
                r0 = 1
            End If

            For i As Integer = 0 To rows.Count - 1
                Dim row() As Object = rows(i)
                For j As Integer = 0 To colCount - 1
                    out(r0 + i, j) = If(j < row.Length, row(j), Nothing)
                Next
            Next

            Return out
        End Function

Private Shared Function CopyArray(values As Array) As Array
            Dim copy As Array = DirectCast(values.Clone(), Array)
            Dim indices(values.Rank - 1) As Integer
            For dimension As Integer = 0 To indices.Length - 1
                indices(dimension) = values.GetLowerBound(dimension)
            Next
            If values.Length = 0 Then Return copy
            Do
                Dim value As Object = values.GetValue(indices)
                If TypeOf value Is Array Then
                    copy.SetValue(CopyArray(DirectCast(value, Array)), indices)
                Else
                    ValidateScalar(value)
                End If
                Dim dimension As Integer = indices.Length - 1
                Do While dimension >= 0
                    indices(dimension) += 1
                    If indices(dimension) <= values.GetUpperBound(dimension) Then Exit Do
                    indices(dimension) = values.GetLowerBound(dimension)
                    dimension -= 1
                Loop
                If dimension < 0 Then Exit Do
            Loop
            Return copy
        End Function

Public Shared Function PvalueCells(model As Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTableOutputModel,
                                          rows As Integer, columns As Integer) As UdfSpillCell38()
            Dim result As New List(Of UdfSpillCell38)()
            Dim firstBodyRow As Integer = model.TitleRows + model.HeaderTopRows
            Dim lastBodyRow As Integer = rows - model.FooterRows - 1
            For Each bodyColumn As Integer In model.PvalueColumns
                Dim columnIndex As Integer = model.HeaderLeftColumns + bodyColumn - 1
                If columnIndex < 0 OrElse columnIndex >= columns Then Continue For
                For rowIndex As Integer = Math.Max(0, firstBodyRow) To Math.Min(lastBodyRow, rows - 1)
                    result.Add(New UdfSpillCell38(rowIndex, columnIndex))
                Next
            Next
            For Each address As Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTableCellAddress In model.PvalueCells
                Dim rowIndex As Integer = firstBodyRow + address.BodyRow - 1
                Dim columnIndex As Integer = model.HeaderLeftColumns + address.BodyColumn - 1
                If rowIndex < firstBodyRow OrElse rowIndex > lastBodyRow Then Continue For
                If columnIndex < 0 OrElse columnIndex >= columns Then Continue For
                result.Add(New UdfSpillCell38(rowIndex, columnIndex))
            Next
            Return result.ToArray()

Public Shared Function IsPValueLabel(label As String) As Boolean
            If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(label) Then Return False
            Dim normalized As New System.Text.StringBuilder(label.Length)
            For Each ch As Char In label
                If Char.IsLetterOrDigit(ch) Then normalized.Append(Char.ToLowerInvariant(ch))
            Next
            Return normalized.ToString().Contains("pvalue")
        End Function

Public Shared Function NormalizeBlanks(table As Object) As Object(,)    
            Dim arr As Object(,) = TryCast(table, Object(,))
            If arr Is Nothing Then Return Nothing
    
            Dim rows As Integer = arr.GetLength(0)
            Dim cols As Integer = arr.GetLength(1)
            Dim out(rows - 1, cols - 1) As Object
    
            For r As Integer = 0 To rows - 1
                For c As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
                    Dim v As Object = arr(r, c)
    
                    If v Is Nothing Then
                        out(r, c) = String.Empty ' ExcelEmpty.Value
                    ElseIf TypeOf v Is DBNull Then
                        out(r, c) = String.Empty ' ExcelEmpty.Value
                    Else
                        out(r, c) = v
                    End If
                Next
            Next
    
            Return out
        End Function

contracts.whole_body:
Public Shared Function BuildLabeledMatrixOutput(matrix(,) As Double,
                                                  rowNames() As String,
                                                  colNames() As String,
                                                  includeHeader As Boolean) As UdfReportProjection38

            If matrix Is Nothing Then Return UdfReportProjection38.FromFault(UdfReportFault38.NotAvailable)

            Dim nRows As Integer = matrix.GetLength(0)
            Dim nCols As Integer = matrix.GetLength(1)

            If rowNames Is Nothing OrElse rowNames.Length <> nRows Then
                ReDim rowNames(nRows - 1)
                For i As Integer = 0 To nRows - 1
                    rowNames(i) = "Row" & (i + 1).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                Next
            End If

            If colNames Is Nothing OrElse colNames.Length <> nCols Then
                ReDim colNames(nCols - 1)
                For j As Integer = 0 To nCols - 1
                    colNames(j) = "Col" & (j + 1).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                Next
            End If

            If Not includeHeader Then
                Dim outNoHdr(nRows - 1, nCols - 1) As Object
                For i As Integer = 0 To nRows - 1
                    For j As Integer = 0 To nCols - 1
                        outNoHdr(i, j) = UdfReportProjection38.SafeNumber(matrix(i, j))
                    Next
                Next
                Return New UdfReportProjection38(New Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTableOutputModel(outNoHdr), UdfReportPreparation38.Raw)
            End If

            Dim out(nRows, nCols) As Object
            out(0, 0) = ""

            For j As Integer = 0 To nCols - 1
                out(0, j + 1) = colNames(j)
            Next

            For i As Integer = 0 To nRows - 1
                out(i + 1, 0) = rowNames(i)
                For j As Integer = 0 To nCols - 1
                    out(i + 1, j + 1) = UdfReportProjection38.SafeNumber(matrix(i, j))
                Next
            Next

            Return New UdfReportProjection38(New Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTableOutputModel(out), UdfReportPreparation38.Raw)
        End Function

Public Shared Function BuildLabeledMatrixOutput(matrix(,) As Double,
                                                  rowNames() As String,
                                                  colNames() As String,
                                                  includeHeader As Boolean) As UdfReportProjection38

            If matrix Is Nothing Then Return UdfReportProjection38.FromFault(UdfReportFault38.NotAvailable)

            Dim nRows As Integer = matrix.GetLength(0)
            Dim nCols As Integer = matrix.GetLength(1)

            If rowNames Is Nothing OrElse rowNames.Length <> nRows Then
                ReDim rowNames(nRows - 1)
                For i As Integer = 0 To nRows - 1
                    rowNames(i) = "Row" & (i + 1).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                Next
            End If

            If colNames Is Nothing OrElse colNames.Length <> nCols Then
                ReDim colNames(nCols - 1)
                For j As Integer = 0 To nCols - 1
                    colNames(j) = "Col" & (j + 1).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                Next
            End If

            If Not includeHeader Then
                Dim outNoHdr(nRows - 1, nCols - 1) As Object
                For i As Integer = 0 To nRows - 1
                    For j As Integer = 0 To nCols - 1
                        outNoHdr(i, j) = UdfReportProjection38.SafeNumber(matrix(i, j))
                    Next
                Next
                Return New UdfReportProjection38(New Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTableOutputModel(outNoHdr), UdfReportPreparation38.Raw)
            End If

            Dim out(nRows, nCols) As Object
            out(0, 0) = ""

            For j As Integer = 0 To nCols - 1
                out(0, j + 1) = colNames(j)
            Next

            For i As Integer = 0 To nRows - 1
                out(i + 1, 0) = rowNames(i)
                For j As Integer = 0 To nCols - 1
                    out(i + 1, j + 1) = UdfReportProjection38.SafeNumber(matrix(i, j))
                Next
            Next

            Return New UdfReportProjection38(New Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTableOutputModel(out), UdfReportPreparation38.Raw)
        End Function

Public Shared Function BuildResidualVectorOutput(vec() As Double, header As String, includeHeader As Boolean) As UdfReportProjection38
            If vec Is Nothing Then Return UdfReportProjection38.FromFault(UdfReportFault38.NotAvailable)

            Dim n As Integer = vec.Length
            Dim outRows As Integer = If(includeHeader, n + 1, n)
            Dim out(outRows - 1, 0) As Object
            Dim r0 As Integer = 0

            If includeHeader Then
                out(0, 0) = header
                r0 = 1
            End If

            For i As Integer = 0 To n - 1
                out(r0 + i, 0) = vec(i)
            Next

            Return New UdfReportProjection38(New Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTableOutputModel(out), UdfReportPreparation38.Raw)
        End Function

Public Shared Function BuildResidualVectorOutput(vec() As Double, header As String, includeHeader As Boolean) As UdfReportProjection38
            If vec Is Nothing Then Return UdfReportProjection38.FromFault(UdfReportFault38.NotAvailable)

            Dim n As Integer = vec.Length
            Dim outRows As Integer = If(includeHeader, n + 1, n)
            Dim out(outRows - 1, 0) As Object
            Dim r0 As Integer = 0

            If includeHeader Then
                out(0, 0) = header
                r0 = 1
            End If

            For i As Integer = 0 To n - 1
                out(r0 + i, 0) = vec(i)
            Next

            Return New UdfReportProjection38(New Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTableOutputModel(out), UdfReportPreparation38.Raw)
        End Function
